parameters.help_en: The list of domain names to query. Separate multiple domain names with vertical bars (|). If you do not specify this parameter, all domain names are queried
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的域名列表，以竖线分割，不传查询全部
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The region. Separate multiple regions with vertical bars (|). Set this parameter to all to query all regions
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The ISP. Separate multiple ISPs with vertical bars (|). Set this parameter to all to query all ISPs
parameters.help_zh: 运营商，竖线分隔，全部填all
parameters.name: isp_name

parameters.help_en: The terminal type. Separate multiple terminal types with vertical bars (|). Set this parameter to all to query all terminal types
parameters.name: platform_type

parameters.help_en: The business type. Separate multiple business types with vertical bars (|). Set this parameter to all to query all business types
parameters.help_zh: 业务类型，竖线分隔，全部填all
parameters.name: business_type

parameters.help_en: The start time. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD format

parameters.help_en: The end time. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD format
parameters.name: end_date

items.description_zh: 单个统计时间片的数据
